about.title: About
about.name: César Heredero Herranz
about.bio:
Ten years in design and digital product. I started as a UX/UI designer consulting for Toyota, Hyundai, Sacyl, Interflora and SHAI Tajo at Devoteam. In 2017 I won the European edition of the Cardio Xplore hackathon organized by Daiichi-Sankyo.

Since 2019 at Flexicar as Senior Product Owner & UX Strategist, where I lead cross-functional projects across product, UX, technical SEO and data in an ecommerce with 30,000+ listings across Spain and Portugal.

I coordinate development, marketing, SEO, editorial and infrastructure teams. My focus: turning product into measurable business levers.
about.q1Desc: I measure before deciding. Pre/post audits, not opinions.
about.q2Desc: I translate between technical and business without losing anyone.
about.q3Desc: I align dev, marketing, SEO, editorial and infra toward one goal.
about.q4Desc: Rigor in the detail, no baroque, no empty process.

process.title: How I work
process.intro: Five phases I apply to almost any project. No baroque, no empty phases just to look methodical.
process.step1Desc: I understand the real business goal before touching anything. The stated problem is rarely the real one.
process.step2Desc: I measure the current state. Data-driven hypotheses, not intuition. I identify the root cause.
process.step3Desc: I define the minimum viable scope with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics before the first ticket.
process.step4Desc: I align dev, marketing, data, SEO and infra. Dependency management and status communication.
process.step5Desc: Pre/post protocol on every change. Results inform the next iteration.
